**Flow 1, revisited — saving with an auto-filled title.** Please try this:

> Paste or type a link address into "Link address", then click somewhere outside that box (so it knows you've finished the address). Watch the **Title** field — you'll see a brief "looking up…", then a title appears on its own. Now click **Save link**.

Then, to check the "still editable" part:

> Enter another link, wait for the title to auto-fill, but this time **change the title** to something of your own before saving.

Two things to confirm:
- Does the title **appearing automatically** (so you rarely have to type it) match how you want quick-saving to feel?
- When you typed over the auto-filled title, it kept **your** version — is that the right behaviour?

One honest note so I'm not misleading you: in this exploration prototype the title is *simulated* from the link address rather than really fetched, so the exact wording it produces isn't meaningful — react to the **behaviour** (it fills in by itself, and you can override it), not to the specific text.
